issue.title: Simplify calendar card and pair it with the weather composition
issue.description:
Refine the Calendar, Weather, and Music showcase placement so the Calendar becomes a compact standalone calendar surface paired with a wider Weather card, while the Music player moves to the left gallery column.

Owner direction:

* Move the Music player out of its current row and place it in the smaller/left gallery column as its own standalone composition.
* Pair the Calendar and Weather compositions side-by-side in one local row at wider container sizes.
* The Calendar should be visually smaller/compact.
* The Weather composition should receive the larger share of the paired row.
* Do not hard-code a specific percentage split; let the worker tune the proportions based on the Calendar's natural width and overall visual balance.
* Do not use equal-width columns for this pair unless browser evidence clearly proves that is visually better, which is not the intended direction.

Calendar simplification:
Remove all surrounding explanatory/summary content from the current Calendar composition.

Remove:

* "Studio offsite" title
* "Pick the days away" subtitle
* Starts summary
* Ends summary
* Length summary
* any extra descriptive/metadata panel around the Calendar

Keep:

* the actual single-month shadcn Calendar
* range selection behavior
* selected start/intermediate/end days
* calendar navigation if already present and geometry-stable
* keyboard/focus behavior
* semantic-token styling
* light/dark behavior

The Calendar card should essentially be the calendar itself, without an additional information panel.

Calendar + Weather paired row:

* Render Calendar and Weather as one intentional side-by-side local group at wider container sizes.
* Calendar is the narrower member.
* Weather is the wider member.
* Exact column proportions are implementation-owned and should be tuned from browser evidence.
* The Calendar should not stretch wider than needed simply to fill space.
* The Weather card may use the additional width naturally.
* Keep both cards aligned cleanly in the local row.
* Avoid fixed pixel widths where responsive grid/flex proportions work better.
* At narrower container widths, allow the pair to stack naturally to avoid overflow.

Music player placement:

* Move the existing Music player to the smaller/left gallery column.
* Preserve its current visual design and lightweight controls unless a small responsive adjustment is required by its new width.
* Do not redesign the Music player as part of this ticket.
* Keep stable geometry and existing token-driven styling.

Architecture constraints:

* Preserve the accepted container-responsive Cards gallery architecture.
* Keep independent vertical flow.
* No masonry.
* No dense packing.
* No absolute positioning.
* Preserve coherent DOM/focus order and responsive collapse.
* Do not alter unrelated gallery compositions.

Design-system constraints:

* Preserve Personal UI semantic tokens.
* Preserve light/dark behavior.
* Keep Calendar based on the official shadcn Calendar resource.
* Keep Weather and Music composition-specific unless a genuinely reusable resource is already involved.
* Do not introduce new network/API/geolocation behavior.

Acceptance:

* Music player appears in the smaller/left gallery column as a standalone card.
* Calendar and Weather appear side-by-side at appropriate wider container widths.
* Calendar is visibly more compact/narrower than Weather.
* Exact Calendar/Weather split is not hard-coded to a fixed percentage requirement.
* Calendar no longer shows title, subtitle, Starts, Ends, Length, or other summary metadata.
* Calendar still shows a single month with functional range selection.
* Weather retains its existing composition and receives the larger visual share of the pair.
* Calendar/Weather pair stacks cleanly at narrower widths.
* No overflow, clipping, focus-order, accessibility, or responsive regression.
